args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
The nightly build fails because `src/money.py` rounds with `ROUND_HALF_UP` while `tests/test_money.py` (and the FIN-212 requirement documented in the docstring) expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This changes the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

CI run ci-0001 on commit 08d3cd5986 passed.
